$allowedGitSourcesComment: Exception list for git dependencies, consulted whenever allowExoticSources
is false. Entries are repositories written as host/owner/repo.
Whitelisting a repository also exempts it from the release-age check.
$trustPolicyComment: pnpm-only, and enforced natively by pnpm: refuses a version published with
weaker guarantees (provenance, trusted publisher) than an earlier one.
$compromisedPackagesComment: Curated list of npm packages that are known to be malicious, maintained by DataDog.

$blockedPackagesExcludeComment: Exception list for blockedPackages, as `name` or `name@version` - exact
It only covers a package that arrived as somebody else's dependency. A command-line
target and a dependency written into the local package.json are still refused
Waiving a package manager here does not make it runnable.
